## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX falling (VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling) and Stocks vs Bonds rising (SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND / TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND ↑ rising) while credit stress signal shows deterioration (HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +0.13%) ABOVE TREND) — rotation into cyclicals rather than broad risk-on.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Stocks over bonds confirming risk tilt: SPY/TLT ↑ via SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress flagged: credit spread (Level 0.7303, 1W: +0.18% | 1M: +1.08%) → flat but ABOVE TREND, consistent with the HYG/LQD signal.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar UUP (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -1.87%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and yield curve in RECOVERY (Yield Curve Level 1.0583, 1W: +0.09% | 1M: -2.23%) indicating slight steepening; overall conditions not tightening materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals showing strength: XLF (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND; Tech also strong but mixed vs financials — XLK (1W: +2.53% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND. Style: cyclicals/value edging, but tech remains a leadership contributor so style mixed.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforming but EM catching up: SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +3.74%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.50% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND — China tech still weaker (KWEB (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation alive but selective: IWM (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +7.35%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +0.46% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND show appetite; Bitcoin ETF IBIT (1W: -0.12% | 1M: +3.50%) CORRECTION signals short-term caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals leading: PPLT (1W: +24.00% | 1M: +50.83%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +43.13%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals/energy also firmer — CPER (1W: +3.83% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +0.38%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas still volatile in RECOVERY — UNG (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -11.95%) RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity leadership with SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +5.57%) ABOVE TREND plus VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) BELOW TREND. DIVERGENCE: pockets of short-term mismatch (XRT, IBIT, XLP showing 1W vs 1M divergences) — minor divergences, not regime-breaking.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/financial exposure: XLF (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND and XLI (Industrials proxy XLI (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength; reduce exposure to defensive RE/Utilities where weak — XLRE (1W: +0.17% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY and XLU (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Materials — XLB/Materials proxy (Materials (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND) and Financials XLF (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -2.58%) BELOW TREND and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.84% | 1M: +5.95%) showing short-term weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Precious metals SLV (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +43.13%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +4.48% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: +6.61% | 1M: -11.95%) RECOVERY remains risky on 1M weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 27.10 (VXX (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -27.38%) BELOW TREND) as complacency check; SPY/TLT 7.8624 (SPY (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND / TLT (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND) as stocks vs bonds pivot; Credit Spread 0.7303 (1W: +0.18% | 1M: +1.08%) as risk-tilt monitor; XLK/XLF 2.6331 (Tech vs Financials, 1W: +2.99% | 1M: -2.50%) as style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and SPY/TLT rising confirm money shifting into cyclicals not a blanket risk-on. Materials, Financials and Metals showing relative strength while credit spread and select commodity divergences are the primary risks to monitor.
